events.context: User provides text describing j2rOS system specs, hardware metaphors, and psychological mappings
User asks: '这和真实的电脑的区别是?' (What is the difference from a real computer?)
User requests: '你可以尽量减少那些文学隐喻和心理学隐喻吗' (Can you reduce literary and psychological metaphors?)
System responds with objective hardware/software differences in tables, filtering metaphors
User instructs: '逆向工程，用他的心智特点设计一台真正的计算机' (Reverse engineer a real computer from his mental traits)
System designs real computer: AMD EPYC CPU, 4x H100 GPUs, FPGA, 2TB RAM, ZFS storage, NPU cards, cost $234k
User comments: '那好像模拟一个人的心智也不是很昂贵啊！' (Simulating a mind doesn't seem expensive!)
System provides low-cost scheme: Ryzen 9, RTX 4090, total ~$4,250 hardware, but highlights data/training costs >$1M
